job.location: Major metropolitan cities such as New York, Chicago, Detroit, and Los Angeles; Raleigh eligibility requires confirmation
job.rawJd:
About the job
Our client is a private equity-backed media and advertising technology company seeking an organized, proactive, and customer-focused Account Manager to join their growing Sales organization as a key member of the Customer Success team. This role is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and is passionate about supporting revenue-generating teams. The Account Manager will own pre-sale coordination, campaign execution, and post-sale support across a portfolio of accounts — serving as a critical operational partner to sellers while ensuring seamless coordination between internal teams and clients throughout the full campaign lifecycle.

Working cross-functionally with Sales, Sales Planning, Ad Operations, Analytics, Commercial Enablement, Finance, and Creative, this individual will help maximize seller productivity, reduce operational friction, deliver successful client outcomes, and create additional selling capacity across the organization.

Candidates need to be in major metropolitan cities like NY, Chicago, Detroit, and Los Angeles.

What Success Looks Like

Becoming a trusted partner to the Sales organization by developing strong cross-functional relationships
Taking ownership of key administrative, proposal, and campaign coordination responsibilities
Improving seller productivity by reducing operational workload and streamlining account support
Ensuring campaigns launch successfully, deliver as expected, and consistently exceed client expectations

Responsibilities

Sales Support & Pre-Sale Coordination

Coordinate RFP responses and proposal development in partnership with Sales, Sales Planning, and Commercial Enablement
Assist in developing and customizing client presentations and approved sales materials
Support account planning through prospect research and competitive intelligence
Maintain CRM opportunities, account records, and pipeline information
Coordinate meetings, agendas, and broader sales logistics
Partner with Sales Planning on inventory availability, targeting recommendations, and budget scenarios

Client Intelligence & Strategic Account Support

Monitor assigned clients for business updates, earnings announcements, product launches, competitive activity, and marketing initiatives
Prepare pre-meeting briefs summarizing relevant client news, campaign history, and strategic opportunities
Proactively identify risks, growth opportunities, and industry trends to inform client conversations
Maintain a strong understanding of each client's planning cycles, business priorities, and annual marketing calendar

Campaign Management & Client Success

Coordinate campaign launches and ensure smooth internal handoffs across teams
Monitor campaign pacing and delivery while coordinating optimization requests and changes
Coordinate reporting, measurement studies, attribution requests, and proof-of-performance deliverables
Ensure ongoing alignment among Sales, Ad Operations, Analytics, and other internal stakeholders throughout campaign execution
Support client communication and help resolve campaign-related issues in a timely manner

Creative & Project Management

Coordinate creative asset collection, trafficking, approvals, and version control
Manage project timelines, deliverables, and milestone tracking
Partner with Creative, Operations, and Commercial Enablement to ensure timely execution

Post-Sale Support & Account Growth

Prepare campaign recap presentations, wrap reports, and performance summaries
Track renewals and identify potential upsell and cross-sell opportunities for Sales partners
Coordinate billing inquiries and invoice follow-up
Provide ongoing administrative and operational support across assigned accounts

Qualifications

Required

1–2 years of professional experience or relevant internship experience in media sales support, account management, customer success, sales operations, or advertising/marketing services
Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
Proficiency with Microsoft Office (particularly Excel and PowerPoint) and AI tools
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple teams
Strong attention to detail, a proactive mindset, and a genuine commitment to delivering high-quality work
A customer-first orientation with a sense of ownership, accountability, and willingness to take initiative

Preferred

Experience supporting advertising sales organizations or media companies
Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM platform
Familiarity with campaign delivery, media planning, or advertising operations workflows
Understanding of digital media, programmatic advertising, retail media, video advertising, or related industries
Experience working with campaign measurement, attribution, or analytics partners

Education

BA/BS degree from an accredited university or equivalent professional experience
